  • Be part of an on-call rotation when need arises.

  • Develop and Review automated reports on a regular cadence to flag suspicious query latency regressions, data divergence bugs, or resource starvation issues to relevant engineering stakeholders.

  • Coding Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience developing using Rust (highly preferred) or a desire to learn Rust with system experience in [C++|Golang].

  • Strong QA and Testing Experience: Proven track record in performance, regression, and reliability validation frameworks. Ability to confidently establish repeatable baselines for distributed data systems.

  • Solid understanding of CS fundamentals with minimum Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of work experience.

  • Comfort using modern AI assistants and tools (e.g., Claude) for quick troubleshooting, on-the-fly utility generation, and analyzing logs and pattern anomalies at scale.

  • Competency working with containerized environments and orchestration frameworks like Docker and Kubernetes, alongside modern CI utilities such as CircleCI.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively work asynchronously.

  • Building distributed systems.

  • Working with database internals and various cloud vendors.

  • Participating in an on-call rotation.

  • Working with distributed products and teams.
